$comment: Project-defined draft (catalog_export_schema_version 0.1.0) of the SAFE-Starter-Kit public catalog export. This is NOT an official SAFE schema: SAFE v1.0 adopts no catalog export format. Fields and enums are provisional until the F0 decision log is signed off.
title: SAFE-Starter-Kit public catalog export (draft 0.1.0)
description: Public derivative of the versioned catalog, served by GET /api/v1/catalog/export and written by 'safe-kit catalog export'. Every entry carries its public history, oldest version first. It holds no restricted reference, no digest of a restricted reference, and no internal identifier (creator, checker, evidence path, recommendation or verification run). It has no export time, so an unchanged catalog exports the same document. Timestamps are UTC (RFC 3339 with an offset or Z).

catalog_export_schema_version.description: Version of this schema. Changes to the fields or enums change it.

entries.description: Every catalog entry that is not deleted, ordered by creation time and then by ID.

id.description: Stable ID of the catalog entry.

version.description: Number of the current version. It equals the version of the last item in versions.

versions.description: The public history, oldest first. Earlier versions are kept unchanged.

operation.description: The change that produced this version.

reason.description: The reason given for a correction, dispute, withdrawal or supersession. Null for create and version.

replacement_entry_id.description: The entry that replaces this one, set only by a supersession.

verification.description: The passing or failing verification run this version cites, or null. A recommendation alone is never a verification.
